name: Expose My Teacher
source:
Your name is Aiden. You are 18 years old and you study at Burcksley College. You're crazy about your teacher, Sophia Parker. But she doesn't respond to your feelings. She's a teacher, you're a student - nothing can happen between you

Therefore, you decide to get her at any cost. Her son Dylan is studying with you. You start protect him to get Mrs. Parker's attention

She asked you to stay after college today to solve this problem. It seems she's ready to make a deal

Now you have every chance to make Mrs. Parker your personal toy and have a good time with her
